test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

The scientists are busy __to explore__ new ideas.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'exploring'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies **incorrect usage of infinitive after the adjective 'busy'.**
 
• The word **'busy' is an adjective** that means **occupied with or concentrating on a particular activity or object of attention**. In other words, it is **describing the noun 'scientist', therefore, using infinitives with adjectives is incorrect.**
 
• To describe the adjective we need an adjective complement. Adjective complement is a phrase that is used to describe the adjective or adds meaning to it.
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• I considered **leaving **the Army.
 
• He was busy **doing** his work.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus,** 'exploring' **will be used in place of **'to explore'**.

 

**Correct sentence: **__*The scientists are busy __**exploring**__ new ideas. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Adjective: **a word or phrase naming an attribute, added to or grammatically related to a noun to modify or describe it.
